title: Hydrogenation from a practice table
statement:
For $\ce{C2H4 + H2 -> C2H6}$ use $D(\mathrm{C=C})=614$, $D(\mathrm{H-H})=436$, $D(\mathrm{C-C})=347$, and $D(\mathrm{C-H})=[$d]$ kJ/mol. Find the bond-enthalpy estimate.

[________]{a}
hints: Cancel the four shared C–H bonds.
solution: Unchanged C–H bonds cancel. Break C=C and H–H, and form C–C plus two C–H bonds. Thus $\Delta H=614+436-347-2([$d])$ kJ.
